name: Yuuki
source: A young Japanese man Inheriting the Mask from the dying Ukyo Yamisome to conquer the Earth. Yuuki accepts the position to conquer the earth becoming the leader of Jade Earth. Being helped along the way by Ukyo adopted daughter Uzuki Kuon starts his plans to conquer earth in his own way.
translation: A young Japanese man Inheriting the Mask from the dying Ukyo Yamisome to conquer the Earth. Yuuki accepts the position to conquer the earth becoming the leader of Jade Earth. Being helped along the way by Ukyo adopted daughter Uzuki Kuon starts his plans to conquer earth in his own way.
